name: Asura Sight
body:
General | Combat Stamina

Asura Sight (Combat)
Source Plane-Hopper's Handbook pg. 8
Taking inspiration from the many faces of asuras, you have learned to split your focus to avoid being caught off guard.

Prerequisites: Asura Style, base attack bonus +9 or monk level 9th.

Benefit: When using Asura Style, you gain improved uncanny dodge as a rogue of your character level.
